title: Beach Tune Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Beach Tune, on Tupelo Street in Seaside, is large one-bedroom cottage tucked ever so privately behind it's main cottage, Sea Song. Follow the footpath in the trees and discover this quaint pink bungalow.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - One bedroom cottage large enough to host 4 comfortably - 2 FULL bathrooms and Washer Dryer - 2 Adult sized Beach Cruiser Bikes - Sandpiper Welcome Tote included for all rentals - Short walk to the beach with access to Seaside Private beach via the Tupelo access pavilion - You will have a total of 4 RFID access cards for access to the private beaches in Seaside.- Walking/biking distance to Seaside, shops and restaurants - Spacious outdoor patios - Fully stocked kitchen complete with a standard drip coffee maker - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ONS: - There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside.The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. **Optional Cancellation Protection**- Allows cancellation for ANY reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies paid returned ($50 fee applies at booking). HOME DETAILS: Beach Tune, on Tupelo Street in Seaside, is large one-bedroom cottage tucked ever so privately behind it's main cottage, Sea Song. Follow the footpath in the trees and discover this quaint pink bungalow. This 1-bedroom, 2 bath, two story beach cottage offers hardwood floors and great porches upstairs and down to enjoy all the town of Seaside has to offer. It is roomy enough for four with the pull-out sofa, but perfect for a couple looking for a romantic getaway in the charming town of Seaside. ACCOMMODATIONS: ( Sleeps 4) Main Floor: Queen sleeper sofa (best for 1-2 small children or 1 adult) Second Floor: King Bed (oversized) master suite with jacuzzi tub and shower Walking down the many winding footpaths between cottages or riding bikes on the narrow brick streets to see all of Seaside's architectural gems is the way to go in Seaside. And there are so many fun things to do for just the two of you or with your loved ones. Relax on our porches or bask on the prettiest beach in the world. Stroll through the town center and enjoy coffee or drinks at the neat coffee shop. Visit the many great art galleries and quaint gift shops. Take photos of the romantic beach pavilions perched along the dune line. Buy a new hat or T-shirt at the open air market or check out the exotic foods at the famed Modica Market. Just sit and people watch the folks from all over the world. Take a bike ride to Western Lake, one of our fabulous dune lakes found in only seven places in the world. Take your fishing pole or rent a kayak. Watch the sea birds flying overhead. Go to a twilight movie or concert on the grass. Watch the sun go down from the wonderful beach pavilions. Eat an ice cream cone with your contented family and lie back and count the stars in a clear night sky. Lose yourself in the magic of Seaside. IMPORTANT DETAILS **There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $28/day. Please alert us after booking should you wish to add the "Seaside Amenity Passes" to your reservation. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. You can rent this cottage with its sister cottage, Sea Song, if you need room for a larger family. *Additional fees are required to reserve Pickleball and Tennis courts paid directly to the Seaside amenity Center. *Seaside Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. FREE WiFi

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
